rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hours from an accredited approver of CE or an approved Oklahoma nursing education program; academic credit (1 semester hour = 16 contact hours); topics must apply to nursing practice
rules.alternatives: CE is one of five options; any one within the 2 years before expiry: 520 hours of employment in a job requiring the license, current nursing specialty certification, a Board-approved refresher course, or 6 semester credit hours of nursing coursework at the current level or higher. Options cannot be combined.
rules.audit_note: Licensee verifies compliance at renewal; if audited, must submit certificates (with the accredited approver named), employment verification form plus job description, or certification copy. Keep documentation through the 2-year period.
rules.notes: Renewed every 2 years by the end of the birth month; RN licenses renew in even-numbered years. The 24 contact hours are only one way to show continuing qualifications for practice (OAC 485:10-7-3).
rules.rule_quote: …Completion of at least twenty-four (24) contact hours of continuing education applicable to nursing practice;…
